column3: Close to the Hebrew; בְּאָהֳלֶךָ (“your tent”) is rendered “Your tabernacle,” and “mountain of holiness” “holy hill.”
Close to the Hebrew; תָּמִים (“blameless”) is rendered “uprightly.”
Close to the Hebrew; “does not slander with his tongue” is rendered “does not backbite,” and “kinsman” “friend.”
Close to the Hebrew; בְּנֶשֶׁךְ (“at interest”) is rendered “at usury.”
